comment: Kapsidelis is an amazing professor. He has many years of newsroom experience that he carries into the classroom. His knowledge of current events and especially gun violence is commendable and he really cares about his students' work. Very soft-spoken and flexible and gives some great articles/chpaters/features to read. Great professor and mentor

You MUST take Kapsidelis for News Writing! He is the best professor - so knowledgeable on the subject and genuinely cares so much about his students. He makes it very clear what you need to know for the exam. Gives helpful feedback on writing assignments (easy) and will give you feedback even before you submit it
